proof.input: domain UTF-8 bytes + NUL + direction UTF-8 bytes + NUL + exact unsigned JSON UTF-8 bytes
proof.semantics: Shared HMAC possession authenticates peer integrity only and never establishes exclusive product authorship.

authorship.publicKeyEncoding: DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo with Ed25519 algorithm identifier and exact pinned key bytes
authorship.publicKeyDigest: Lowercase sha256-prefixed digest of the exact DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo bytes
authorship.statement: The signature covers exactly the canonical JSON bytes of the statement object, without a trailing LF; envelope is the exact signed envelope object including its controllerProof.
verificationOrder: compiled-in Ed25519 SPKI type and bytes

contractArtifact.digest: SHA-256 of the entire immutable LF-terminated contract artifact
contractArtifact.replication: Product and orchestrator copies are byte-identical.
contractArtifact.selfReference: The digest value is external; this artifact does not embed its own digest value.

manifestBinding.mappingRule: The three existing manifest-v4 owner-image values remain byte-for-byte fields of manifest-v4, must already be equal, and map unchanged into activation binding.ownerArtifactDigest; no manifest-v4 field is renamed.
manifestBinding.openCodeArtifactDigest: Each admission-v1 route openCodeBinding.openCodeArtifactDigest binds only the installed OpenCode executable and is allowed and positively required to differ from ownerArtifactDigest in the golden vector.

operationalWire.digestDistinction: wireCapabilityDigest is a production capability digest and is distinct from the operational golden artifact SHA-256.

canonicalEncoding.json: UTF-8, no BOM, no CR, no insignificant whitespace, schema-defined object-key order, no unknown keys, and no duplicate keys
canonicalEncoding.digests: Lowercase hexadecimal with the specified bare or sha256-prefixed form
canonicalEncoding.admission: The embedded admission is the complete canonical admission-v1 object; its raw source bytes end in exactly one LF.
canonicalEncoding.socketFrame: One canonical JSON object followed by exactly one LF; digest and proof inputs exclude the transport LF unless explicitly stated.

protocol.challenge: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; owner_ready and ready echo the prepare challenge exactly.

bindingSemantics.approvalDigest: SHA-256, with sha256: prefix, of canonical JSON without LF for {schemaVersion:1,approvalGeneration,authorities}, where authorities are all global admission route authority objects in route order.
bindingSemantics.admissionDocumentDigest: SHA-256, with sha256: prefix, of the complete canonical admission-v1 raw bytes including exactly one terminal LF.
bindingSemantics.ownerArtifactDigest: SHA-256, with sha256: prefix, of only the built orchestrator owner artifact, mapped from unchanged signed manifest-v4 owner-image fields.
bindingSemantics.activationDigest: Bare lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the exact publication JSON bytes without transport LF.
bindingSemantics.routeIdentity: (teamId,runId,laneId,sessionId) is globally unique; routeId order is lexicographic; providerId is exactly opencode.

order: Authenticate authorship, HMAC, and validate the complete global admission document and its global digests.
Retain routes whose authority.teamId exactly equals signed binding.teamId, preserving global route order.
Retain only actor mappings cross-bound by the retained routes.
Derive the immutable view team ID only from signed binding.teamId.
Preserve global admission generation, approvalDigest, admissionDocumentDigest, raw-byte currentness fence, and route order.
globalTeamDerivation.ambientState: Routes and actors are never reconstructed from launch-plan or ambient state.
globalTeamDerivation.unroutedActors: Admission-v1 has no team tag for actors without a retained route; those actors fail closed.

activationLifecycle: Publish a private mode-0600 owner socket with the approval delegate unavailable.
Verify the HMAC prepare and exact binding, then return owner_ready.
Verify publication authorship, HMAC, complete admission, descriptor currentness, and every pin.
Derive the team view and run recoverStateOnly with no provider effects.
Recheck socket, bootstrap/root authority, activation lease, raw admission file identity and bytes, and every pin.
Atomically install the recovered delegate and a new local monotonic activation epoch.
Retain that exact connection as the activation lease; every extra frame is a revocation event.

revocation.order: First clear the delegate and increment the local monotonic activation epoch, then clean up.
revocation.reactivation: After lease loss, the same owner generation/process cannot reactivate; a new owner generation/process is required.
revocation.authorizationTokens: All authorization tokens are activation-epoch-bound and invalidated on revoke.

jointFences: route identity uniqueness and lexicographic route-ID order
plan and credential generation/ID, runtime instance, session, and delivery owner
actor principal/mapping and scope authority generation
owner artifact digest, OpenCode executable digest, session-record fingerprint, and live-effect fingerprint
global admission digest, WAL writer fence, and local monotonic activation-lease epoch
effectFencing.providerBoundary: The combined activation/admission/WAL final effect token is consumed synchronously immediately before the provider call; after revocation nothing lacking a consumed combined token may reach OpenCode.
effectFencing.afterBoundary: A proven terminal receipt remains publishable under WAL CAS. A missing or ambiguous receipt remains operator_required; revocation never invents success or turns a proven result into ambiguity.

gateSequencing: All three gates are enabled in the exact candidate artifacts before built-artifact E1; only after E1 succeeds may those same exact refs be published in one coordinated manifest rollout.
